verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is an API-first transcription service with documented v2 job endpoints for creating jobs by URL or upload and for reading status and results, plus auth-test and health endpoints, webhooks, and SSE streaming. A probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly served at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of real-world API usage, since all docs evidence is vendor-claimed and the GitHub skill is first-party.
